recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, top-down perspective of a male figure lying on a pink and white bed, framed by a grid of mirrored panels reflecting warm stage lights. The aesthetic is heavily saturated with 1970s glam-rock influences, featuring vibrant pinks, oranges, and cyan typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Overhead perspective creates a flat, graphic layout of the subject.
Warm orange light bulbs contrast against the cool cyan text.
Geometric grid of mirrors breaks the background into rhythmic segments.
Subject's magenta jacket anchors the central color palette.
coreInvariants: High-saturation pink and magenta color story

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure lying diagonally across the bed, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The magenta jacket of the subject serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold cyan text at the top, move down the diagonal line of the subject, and settle on the mirrored reflections at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, mirrored floor areas provide contrast to the bright bed linens.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with deep black shadows in the mirror gaps.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to high-contrast primaries and secondaries

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif aesthetic and blocky terminals.
Provides the necessary geometric slab feel common in 70s design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a top-down photograph of a man with 70s hair lying on a pink and white bed. The bed is surrounded by a grid of mirrored tiles reflecting warm orange stage lights. High saturation, magenta tones, vintage film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of centered, extra-bold cyan slab-serif text at the top. Ensure the text is large and tightly spaced.

verificationChecks: Is the typography a heavy cyan slab serif?
Are there warm orange light reflections in the mirrors?
Is the color palette dominated by magenta and pink?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the busy background
Verify the diagonal alignment of the subject
Confirm the presence of the mirrored grid
recipe.reuseFormula: Overhead perspective + Mirrored grid background + Magenta/Cyan color contrast + Heavy slab-serif typography.
